passage.text: It's April now, and it's the hot season here in Thailand.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈeɪprəl ˈnaʊ, ənd ɪts ðə ˈhɑːt ˌsiːzən ˈhɪr ɪn ˈtaɪlænd.

passage.text: It's about 38°C every day, so I sweat a lot.
passage.reading: ɪts əˈbaʊt ˌθɜːrti ˈeɪt dɪˈɡriːz ˈsɛlsiəs ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ, soʊ aɪ ˈswɛt ə ˈlɑːt.

passage.text: I always use sunscreen when I go out.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈjuːz ˈsʌnskriːn wɛn aɪ ˈɡoʊ ˈaʊt.

passage.text: The air conditioning in my room is my best friend!
passage.reading: ði ˈɛr kənˌdɪʃənɪŋ ɪn maɪ ˈruːm ɪz maɪ ˈbɛst ˈfrɛnd!

passage.text: Is it cold and snowy at home now?
passage.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈkoʊld ənd ˈsnoʊi ət ˈhoʊm ˈnaʊ?

passage.text: A Canadian winter is freezing, but the Thai hot season is hotter than a Canadian summer!
passage.reading: ə kəˈneɪdiən ˈwɪntər ɪz ˈfriːzɪŋ, bʌt ðə ˈtaɪ ˈhɑːt ˌsiːzən ɪz ˈhɑːtər ðən ə kəˈneɪdiən ˈsʌmər!
